detail.longDescription: I made a search engine to find fashion deals across hundreds of independent fashion retailers. Fun technical stuff: - It doesn't do any webpage parsing to fill the index, instead relying on the UCP protocol. - It uses a complex deterministic engine that merges listings based on very messy and unreliable data from retailers (no, Jev can't do that). - It parses shipping rules and compares prices after delivery and duties. - It is built on Hono, Vue, and Inertia, and fits on cheapest hetzner VM (app, merging engine, db). - It has MCP-less AI support, via serving markdown alternatives for every page.
